message.subject: Reschedule my knee follow-up
message.body_html:
Hello,

I have a follow-up on Wednesday, November 4 at 9:00 AM, but I have a conflict that morning. Could we move it to Tuesday, November 3 at 2:00 PM?

Thank you,
Barnaby Gourdsworth

Hello Barnaby,

Thank you for your message about changing your appointment.
You asked about Tuesday, November 3 at 2:00 PM in your message.
A member of our scheduling team will contact you to find a time that works.

If you need us sooner, call (212) 555-0142 or sign in to the patient portal at https://portal.hollowveil.example.

Hollowveil Memorial Hospital, Patient Services
